text:
nina: Heads up — repro for sidebar search returning results from the previous org when you flip tabs quickly. Repro steps below; seen on prod canary.

Steps:
1) Sign in as admin to org A
2) Open sidebar search, query "invoice 2025"
3) Quickly switch to org B via quick-org switcher
4) Open sidebar search again — results include rows from org A

Not super deterministic, maybe ~1/10 tries. Seems like a race between prefetch/cache and the org switch.

Logs I grabbed: 
```json
{"req_id":"r1","route":"/api/search","org":"B","cache_key":"search:invoice 2025"}
{"req_id":"r0","route":"/api/search","org":"A","cache_key":"search:invoice 2025"}
```

Anyone else repro or have ideas? @devon @chris

chris: Repro'd locally after a few tries. Client stores last query in SWR cache keyed only by query string. When you switch org fast the component re-renders and picks the cached result before the new request completes.

devon: Yea that matches what I saw. Our prefetcher uses a memoized fetcher keyed by just the query. Quick fixes: include orgId in the cache key, and cancel inflight requests on org switch (AbortController).

anya: Also worth auditing server/edge caching. If CDN/edge uses query-only cache keys or we forgot Vary: X-Org, edge could hand back the previous org's response.

nina: Good call. Chris/Devon — who wants to own quick mitigation? I can do client PR to change key to ['search', orgId, q] + cancel.

chris: Client-first. Small PR, low risk. I'll open an infra ticket for CDN Vary headers if you can land the client fix.

devon: I'll pair with nina on the PR. Proposed patch snippet:
```js
const key = ['sidebar-search', orgId, query];
const controller = new AbortController();
useEffect(() => () => controller.abort(), [orgId]);
const { data } = useSWR(key, () => fetchSearch(query, { signal: controller.signal }));
```

Also add telemetry tags `org_id` and `request_source=sidebar` so we can surface misattribution in metrics.

nina: Perfect. I'll add a unit test for the cache key and a tiny e2e that rapidly switches orgs.

anya: :+1: I'm opening an infra ticket to audit `Vary`/cache-control on the search route. If we find a header issue we'll need a fast rollback/patch plan.

deploy-bot: new-canary-deploy scheduled by @nina — canary window 15m starting 1758012000

chris: After the PR lands can we run a short canary focused on a power-user org that frequently switches (ops team)? Also add a small dashboard card in Console ops showing `sidebar_search_misattributed_total`.

nina: Yes — will coordinate with ops. Assigning devon as PR author, chris as reviewer. I'll post the PR link when ready.

devon: On it. ETA ~2h.
